bio: The menu at this inviting restaurant features a fantastic range of regional classics and Asian dishes. Popular choices range from Wiener schnitzel to pan-fried Arctic char or Thai curry. No matter what you plump for, you can expect high-quality ingredients, skilful preparation, character and plenty of flavour. Warm wood panelling lends the dining spaces a cosy rustic feel; friendly and professional service make your dining experience complete. In summer, the charming terrace beckons....
